$comment: Every product served by apt.stack256.org. This file is the ONLY place a product is named — nothing in the workflow hardcodes one. Adding a product here is all that is needed for its packages, and optionally its installer script, to appear on the site. Removing it here removes them on the next run, with no other product affected and no leftover files, because the index and the site are rebuilt from scratch every time.

products.$comment_installer: Optional. `installer` is the path within the product's own repository; `publish_as` is the path it is served at on apt.stack256.org. Omit both for a product with no installer script. Two products must not claim the same `publish_as` — the workflow refuses rather than letting one silently overwrite another.
